summary.en: Shiratori, Chiba, and Sato are asking an old woman if she’s ever seen a suspicious person or known Yagi, to which she answers not at all. When the police tell the lady where Yagi fell, she begins to express her fear as there was a woman who lived there and jumped out of the building exactly one week ago. But before Sato can ask for more information about the suicide, there is a scream stating that there is someone died, so they arrive at the place where the one who screamed points at. In a shocking turn, Yumi is the one lying down exactly where Yagi did earlier, at first Sato cries for her death but is later surprised when learns that Takagi forgets to inform her and the others that Yumi asked him if she could lie there to see what had Yagi tried to look at, which was the no parking sign. At this moment, Sato remembers that in the first scene, at the direction Momosaki was looking at, there is also a no parking sign like this one. Takagi also informs that the number Yagi was trying to make a call was 7155, so Yumi tries to call Naeko to confirm if Karaoke has a song corresponding to that number, to which she says no. Everyone decides to go ask for information somewhere else while Yumi goes home following others' recommendation.
